en: Conditioned by a state not accompanied by rapture that is unwholesome, a state accompanied by rapture that is wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-eight [instances] for root; ... pe ... twenty-eight for non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state not accompanied by rapture that is not unwholesome, a state accompanied by rapture that is unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-eight [instances] for root; ... pe ... twenty-eight for non-disappearance.
A state not accompanied by rapture that is indeterminate is related to a state accompanied by rapture that is indeterminate by way of object condition.
Condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-eight in the object condition; twenty-eight in the predominance and proximity conditions ... pe ... twenty-eight in the decisive support condition;
twenty-four in the kamma condition; twenty-eight in the absence and disappearance conditions.
